chart.name: Partition Replicas State

noDataOptions.noDataMessage: Currently, no data is available for this chart

chart.programText:
A = data('kafka.partition.replicas', rollup='latest').sum(by=['topic', 'partition']).publish(label='A')
B = data('kafka.partition.replicas_in_sync', rollup='latest').sum(by=['topic', 'partition']).publish(label='B')
C = (A-B).sum(by=['topic', 'partition']).publish(label='C')

chart.programText:
